create_anthropic_client: create an AnthropicClient instance with a Claude model name and optional base URL
build_llm_instance: build a configured ChatAnthropic LLM instance with passthrough kwargs like timeout and max_tokens
test_validate_model: test the validate_model method to verify an Anthropic model name is valid
review_normalized_invoke: review the NormalizedChatAnthropic invoke method that normalizes content blocks to strings
summarize_passthrough_kwargs: summarize the _PASSTHROUGH_KWARGS tuple containing timeout, max_retries, api_key, and other config options
